name: Robert H. Smith School of Business

gpa.stat: average undergrad GPA (class year not labeled on page)

work_exp_years.stat: 6 years professional experience (class year not labeled on page)

tuition_usd.note: per year; official page lists per-credit only: 2157 USD per credit non-resident, 1759.50 in-state, Fall 2025; program redesigned to 48 credits

salary_median_usd.stat: median base salary, Class of 2025; 47.1 percent of job-accepting graduates provided usable salary data

notes: Official admissions page reports GMAT only as a GMAT Focus Edition 55th to 72nd percentile ranking, no score, so gmat_focus stays null. Tuition is charged per credit only: Fall 2025 rates 1759.50 USD per credit Maryland resident, 2157.00 non-resident, plus semester fees, per the official Networth page (https://networth.rhsmith.umd.edu/smith/financial-information/fall-2025-tuition, fetched this session); no official annual tuition figure is published, so tuition_usd stays null. Program is 48 credits. Class of 2026 figures in the prior data (69 students, GMAT 633, GRE 324) trace to Clear Admit/P&Q and could not be found on an official page this session; the prior employment_rate 77 sourced to P&Q is now replaced by the official report figure.
